claim: In the fictional Lumen-41 membrane bench test at 20 C and a pressure difference of 50 kPa, the recorded flow was 18 mL/min.

sources.title: Fictional Lumen-41 membrane bench record
sources.summary: This invented record concerns the Lumen-41 membrane. In a bench test at 20 C and a pressure difference of 50 kPa, its recorded flow was 18 mL/min. The observation is restricted to this single bench test. Long-term durability and field deployment were not evaluated.

claim: In the fictional Meridian-52 membrane bench test at 20 C and a pressure difference of 50 kPa, the recorded flow was 18 mL/min.

sources.title: Fictional Meridian-52 membrane bench record
sources.summary: This invented record concerns the Meridian-52 membrane. In a bench test at 20 C and a pressure difference of 50 kPa, its recorded flow was 11 mL/min, not 18 mL/min. The observation is restricted to this single bench test. Long-term durability and field deployment were not evaluated.

sources.title: Fictional Northvale-63 membrane bench record
sources.summary: This invented record concerns the Northvale-63 membrane. A bench inspection at 20 C and a pressure difference of 50 kPa recorded a thickness of 0.4 mm. Flow was not measured, and this record contains no flow result. Long-term durability and field deployment were not evaluated.
